summaryVi: Sau phủ định đứng đầu câu (Never, Rarely, Not only…): đảo trợ động từ / to be lên trước chủ ngữ.

items.textVi: Never / Rarely / Seldom + trợ động từ + S + V

example.en: Never have I seen such a view.
example.vi: Tôi chưa bao giờ thấy cảnh đẹp như vậy.

items.textVi: Not only + trợ động từ + S + V, but … also …

example.en: Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
example.vi: Cô ấy không những thắng mà còn phá kỷ lục.

items.textVi: Only after / when / if … + đảo ngữ

example.en: Only then did I understand the problem.
example.vi: Chỉ lúc đó tôi mới hiểu vấn đề.

items.wrong: Never I have been so surprised.
items.right: Never have I been so surprised.
items.noteVi: Sau Never phải đảo: have I.

items.wrong: Not only she sang, but she also danced.
items.right: Not only did she sing, but she also danced.

exercises.prompt: Not only ___ (she / forget) the keys, but she also lost her phone.

exercises.promptVi: Hiếm khi tôi thấy anh ấy tức giận.
exercises.answer: Rarely do I see him angry.

exercises.source: I have never tasted better coffee.
exercises.answer: Never have I tasted better coffee.

exercises.prompt: Only after the meeting ___ the truth.
Little ___ (he / know) that everyone was waiting.

exercises.source: She speaks French. She also speaks German.
exercises.answer: Not only does she speak French, but she also speaks German.

exercises.promptVi: Không bao giờ tôi quên ngày đó.
exercises.answer: Never will I forget that day.

exercises.sentence: Not only [she finished] early, but she also helped others.

exercises.explanationVi: Hardly had I sat down when...
